questions.question: In your work maintaining and upgrading OBIEE repositories and dashboards, how did you investigate a performance issue and determine the appropriate fix?
Describe a time you coordinated with developers, QA, ETL, database teams, and customers to resolve a production or pre-production issue. What was your role and how was it resolved?
What experience do you have with SQL performance tuning, and how would you diagnose a slow query or report backed by an Oracle database?

This role involves designing cloud-based microservices for video-processing workflows. How would you approach decomposing a workflow into services, defining service boundaries, and designing the APIs between them?
What is your hands-on experience with Go or PHP? Please describe a project, feature, or codebase you have built or maintained using either language.
How would you package a service in Docker, manage its configuration across development, test, and production environments, and troubleshoot a container that fails after deployment?
What AWS or Google Cloud services have you used, and how did you use them to deploy, operate, or troubleshoot an application?

The platform shares video content with external partners such as Apple, Amazon, and YouTube. How would you design an API or delivery integration that is reliable, secure, observable, and able to handle retries or partner-side failures?

Describe your experience with release processes, including code reviews, unit testing, system integration testing, defect triage, and go-live support. What improvements would you make to streamline CI/CD?

This role works with video packaging and streaming workflows. What is your current understanding of transcoding, media containers, codecs such as H.264/AVC or HEVC, and adaptive streaming formats, and how would you get productive in this domain?
